text_block_list.text:
I need to ask Нарита Таисин something,
so I go
looking for her on the rooftop. I
don't see her
right away, but then I hear
a voice...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, another ad? I've hardly been able
to
progress the story because of these
damn ads...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's this one? "Real results in just
three
days!" "Get rid of old, dead skin
cells!" "Reveal a
fresher, brighter you!"
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
Don't even think about buying shady products
like that!

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Don't scare me like that. I'm not
gullible
enough to believe something so
stupid, anyway!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So she says, but it seems like she's
worried about
her skin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
